mapper.insert: insert into teacher_host( lab_id, teacher_device_id, host_ip, port, status, token, last_heartbeat_time ) values( #{labId}, #{teacherDeviceId}, #{hostIp}, #{port}, #{status}, #{token}, #{lastHeartbeatTime} ) on duplicate key update host_ip = values(host_ip), port = values(port), status = values(status), token = values(token), last_heartbeat_time = values(last_heartbeat_time), updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select id, lab_id as labId, teacher_device_id as teacherDeviceId, host_ip as hostIp, port, status, token, last_heartbeat_time as lastHeartbeatTime, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from teacher_host where lab_id = #{labId} and status = 'online' order by last_heartbeat_time desc, id desc limit 1
